subtopics.label: Depression: Treatment, Neurobiology, and Mechanisms
subtopics.description: Research on the neurobiological underpinnings of major depressive disorder and its subtypes, including pharmacological treatments (antidepressants, ketamine, TMS, ECT), psychotherapies (CBT, PATH, Engage & Connect), brain imaging correlates, and machine learning approaches to predict treatment response and parse depression heterogeneity.
subtopics.short_description: Neurobiological mechanisms, pharmacological and psychotherapeutic treatments, and predictive models for major depressive disorder.

subtopics.label: Suicide Risk, Prevention, and Self-Harm
subtopics.description: Epidemiological, clinical, and computational research on suicidal ideation, suicide attempts, and non-suicidal self-injury across the lifespan, including risk stratification models using EHRs and machine learning, geographic and social determinants of suicide risk, prevention interventions, and NLP-based detection of suicidality in clinical text.
subtopics.short_description: Epidemiological and computational research on suicidal ideation, self-harm, risk stratification, and prevention interventions across the lifespan.

subtopics.label: Perinatal and Reproductive Mental Health
subtopics.description: Clinical and biological research on mental health conditions during pregnancy and the postpartum period, including postpartum depression prediction and treatment, perinatal anxiety, neurosteroid and immune mechanisms, and reproductive psychiatry education and interventions.
subtopics.short_description: Clinical and biological research on depression, anxiety, and neurosteroid mechanisms during pregnancy and the postpartum period.

subtopics.label: Schizophrenia, Psychosis, and Neurodevelopmental Mechanisms
subtopics.description: Translational and clinical research on schizophrenia and related psychotic disorders, encompassing patient-derived organoid models, blood-brain barrier dysfunction, proteomic and neuroimaging biomarkers, negative symptom dimensions, antipsychotic prescribing patterns, cognitive training, and early psychosis intervention financing.
subtopics.short_description: Translational and clinical research on psychosis mechanisms, biomarkers, cognitive training, and early intervention for schizophrenia-spectrum conditions.

subtopics.label: Anxiety Disorders, PTSD, and Trauma
subtopics.description: Research on anxiety disorders, PTSD, and trauma-related conditions including fear extinction, VR-based and MDMA-assisted therapies, vasopressin receptor antagonists, childhood trauma effects, prolonged grief disorder, and the neurobiological and psychosocial correlates of trauma across the lifespan.
subtopics.short_description: Neurobiological and psychosocial research on fear, trauma, and PTSD, including VR-based, MDMA-assisted, and pharmacological therapies.

subtopics.label: Late-Life Depression, Aging, and Cognitive Comorbidity
subtopics.description: Clinical research focused on depression in older adults, including its relationship to cognitive impairment, small vessel disease, apathy, and executive dysfunction; psychotherapeutic and pharmacological interventions; ecological momentary assessment; and the intersection of depression with aging-related neurobiological changes.
subtopics.short_description: Depression in older adults and its links to cognitive impairment, small vessel disease, and aging-related neurobiological changes.

subtopics.label: Autism Spectrum Disorder and Pediatric Neurodevelopment
subtopics.description: Research on autism spectrum disorder and related neurodevelopmental conditions, including molecular and neuroimaging mechanisms, social skills interventions, diagnostic disclosure, caregiver-implemented strategies, and comorbid behavioral conditions such as ADHD and conduct problems in children.
subtopics.short_description: Molecular, neuroimaging, and behavioral research on autism and related neurodevelopmental conditions in children.

subtopics.label: Digital Health, AI, and Technology in Mental Health
subtopics.description: Research on the application of artificial intelligence, machine learning, natural language processing, wearable devices, mobile apps, and chatbots to detect, predict, monitor, and treat mental health conditions including depression, anxiety, suicide risk, and postpartum depression.
subtopics.short_description: Machine learning, NLP, wearables, and mobile apps applied to detection, monitoring, and treatment of psychiatric conditions.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 Pandemic and Mental Health
subtopics.description: Studies examining the psychological impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on the general population, healthcare workers, college students, and psychiatric patients, including trends in psychological distress, telemental health expansion, inpatient psychiatry adaptations, and pandemic-related changes in child and adolescent mental health.
subtopics.short_description: Psychological distress, telehealth expansion, and psychiatric care adaptations across populations during the COVID-19 pandemic.

subtopics.label: Mental Health Services, Policy, and Health Systems
subtopics.description: Health services and policy research on mental health care delivery, including behavioral health homes, mental health parity enforcement, integration of mental health into primary and specialty care, early psychosis program financing, telehealth policy, and access to mental health services across diverse populations.
subtopics.short_description: Health services and policy research on care integration, parity enforcement, telehealth, and access across diverse populations.

subtopics.label: Prolonged Grief Disorder and Bereavement
subtopics.description: Clinical and psychometric research on prolonged grief disorder (PGD), including validation of diagnostic scales (PG-13, PG-13-R) across multiple languages and cultures, neurobiological reward system correlates, risk factors, comorbidity with depression and suicidal ideation, and treatment approaches.
subtopics.short_description: Diagnostic validation, neurobiological correlates, risk factors, and treatment of prolonged grief disorder across cultures.

subtopics.label: Behavioral Health in Palliative, Hospice, and Serious Illness Care
subtopics.description: Research on the integration of mental health and psychiatric services into palliative care, hospice, and serious illness settings, including prevalence of psychiatric comorbidities, training of palliative care clinicians in mental health, depression screening, and interventions for patients and caregivers at end of life.
subtopics.short_description: Integration of psychiatric services into palliative, hospice, and serious illness settings for patients and caregivers.

subtopics.label: Stress Neurobiology and Brain Circuit Mechanisms
subtopics.description: Preclinical and translational research on the neurobiological mechanisms of stress, including frontostriatal and limbic circuits, paraventricular thalamus, BDNF signaling, sex differences in stress responses, and animal models of chronic stress relevant to depression, anxiety, and motivated behavior.
subtopics.short_description: Preclinical and translational research on frontostriatal, limbic, and thalamic circuits underlying stress, depression, and anxiety.

subtopics.label: Eating Disorders, Body Image, and Body Dysmorphic Disorder
subtopics.description: Clinical research on anorexia nervosa, binge eating disorder, body dysmorphic disorder, and body image disturbance, including treatment predictors, CBT versus supportive psychotherapy comparisons, perfectionism, and comorbid psychiatric conditions.
subtopics.short_description: Clinical research on anorexia, binge eating, body dysmorphic disorder, and treatment predictors including CBT outcomes.

subtopics.label: Pediatric Delirium and Critical Care Mental Health
subtopics.description: Research on delirium screening, prevention, and outcomes in pediatric intensive care and hospital settings, including assessment tools, risk factors, and post-discharge quality of life. Also covers parental and provider distress in prolonged PICU admissions.
subtopics.short_description: Delirium screening, prevention, and outcomes in pediatric intensive care, including parental and provider distress.

subtopics.label: Dementia Caregiving: Burden, Self-Efficacy, and Psychosocial Interventions
subtopics.description: Studies examining psychological burden, self-efficacy, depression, and well-being among family caregivers of persons with dementia, including interventions such as positive emotion regulation, social enhancement tools, and cross-cultural analyses of familism and caregiver outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Psychological burden, self-efficacy, and psychosocial interventions for family caregivers of persons with dementia.

subtopics.label: Cancer Survivorship: Psychosocial Outcomes and Quality of Life
subtopics.description: Research on psychological distress, quality of life, anxiety, and unmet psychosocial needs among cancer survivors and patients, including breast cancer, gynecologic cancer, and young adult survivors, as well as disparities in psychosocial care utilization.
subtopics.short_description: Psychological distress, quality of life, and disparities in psychosocial care among cancer survivors and patients.

subtopics.label: Adolescent and Young Adult Substance Use: Risk, Neurodevelopment, and Intervention
subtopics.description: Studies on alcohol, cannabis, e-cigarette, and stimulant use among adolescents and young adults, including neurobiological effects, risk factors, sex differences, and prevention or treatment interventions for substance use disorders in youth.
subtopics.short_description: Neurobiological effects, risk factors, and interventions for alcohol, cannabis, and stimulant use in adolescents and young adults.

subtopics.label: Chronic Pain: Psychosocial Factors, Comorbidities, and Behavioral Interventions
subtopics.description: Research on the intersection of chronic pain with psychological distress, depression, inflammation, and functional outcomes, including peer-delivered and behavioral interventions for pain management in diverse populations such as diabetes patients, older adults, and torture survivors.
subtopics.short_description: Intersection of chronic pain with psychological distress, depression, and inflammation, including peer-delivered behavioral interventions.

subtopics.label: Post-COVID Neuropsychiatric and Cognitive Sequelae
subtopics.description: Studies examining cognitive deficits, neuropsychiatric symptoms, and functional impairment following COVID-19 infection, including long COVID subphenotypes, rehabilitation approaches, and digital interventions for post-COVID cognitive recovery.
subtopics.short_description: Cognitive deficits, neuropsychiatric symptoms, and rehabilitation approaches following COVID-19 infection and long COVID.

subtopics.label: Physician and Trainee Burnout, Wellness, and Professional Distress
subtopics.description: Research on burnout, psychological distress, and wellness among physicians, trainees, and healthcare workers across specialties, including cardiothoracic surgery, pediatric gastroenterology, radiology, and home health aides, with attention to COVID-19 impacts on provider well-being.
subtopics.short_description: Burnout, psychological distress, and wellness among physicians, trainees, and healthcare workers across specialties.

subtopics.label: Pediatric Behavioral and Mental Health Training and Workforce Development
subtopics.description: Studies on training pediatricians, residents, and fellows in behavioral and mental health competencies, including curriculum development, clinical training environments, and the role of onsite mental health professionals in improving trainee skills and confidence.
subtopics.short_description: Curriculum development and clinical training to build behavioral and mental health competencies among pediatric providers.

subtopics.label: Social Isolation, Loneliness, and Social Connectedness in Older Adults
subtopics.description: Research on the health consequences of loneliness and social isolation in older adults, including associations with depression, physical health, and quality of life, as well as technology-based and community interventions to enhance social connectedness.
subtopics.short_description: Health consequences of social isolation in older adults and technology-based or community interventions to improve connectedness.

subtopics.label: HIV, Mental Health, and Aging: Psychosocial and Neuropsychiatric Comorbidities
subtopics.description: Studies on psychiatric symptoms, cognitive decline, inflammation, pain, and psychosocial needs in people living with HIV, with particular focus on older adults, the impact of childhood trauma, and palliative care needs in this population.
subtopics.short_description: Psychiatric symptoms, cognitive decline, and psychosocial needs in older adults living with HIV, including palliative care.

subtopics.label: Adolescent Psychiatric Inpatient and Partial Hospitalization Programs
subtopics.description: Research on assessment, treatment, and outcomes in adolescent acute psychiatric settings including partial hospitalization and inpatient programs, covering anxiety prevalence, measurement-based care, treatment needs, police involvement, and digital media-related admissions.
subtopics.short_description: Assessment, treatment, and outcomes in adolescent inpatient and partial hospitalization psychiatric programs.

subtopics.label: Bipolar Disorder: Neurobiological Mechanisms and Treatment Approaches
subtopics.description: Studies investigating the neurobiological underpinnings of bipolar disorder including oxidative stress, GSK-3β signaling, and TRPV1 channels, as well as treatment approaches such as TMS, GLP-1 agonists, and stimulant use in comorbid conditions.
subtopics.short_description: Neurobiological underpinnings of bipolar disorder, including oxidative stress and GSK-3β signaling, and emerging treatment approaches.

subtopics.label: Telepsychiatry and Consultation-Liaison Psychiatry Services
subtopics.description: Research on the implementation, effectiveness, and triage of telepsychiatry consultation-liaison services in hospital and emergency department settings, including centralized telepsychiatry models, hybrid consultation approaches, and healthcare utilization patterns following psychiatric hospitalization.
subtopics.short_description: Implementation and effectiveness of telepsychiatry consultation models in hospital and emergency department settings.

subtopics.label: Racial, Ethnic, and Socioeconomic Disparities in Mental Health and Care Access
subtopics.description: Studies examining how race, ethnicity, socioeconomic status, and structural racism contribute to disparities in mental health outcomes, treatment access, and psychosocial care utilization, including impacts on youth, college students, and minority communities.
subtopics.short_description: Structural racism, ethnicity, and socioeconomic factors driving disparities in psychiatric outcomes and treatment access.
